title: Missing rice trader found stabbed to death in Occidental Mindoro
summary: A 35-year-old rice trader who had been missing for several days was found dead in a cornfield in Sitio Amnay, Barangay Barahan, Sta. Cruz, Occidental Mindoro, on Friday morning.
